title: US Census boundaries (for maps)
description: US state and county polygons from bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries (TIGER/Line). Verified against BigQuery on 2026-10-08.
rules: Boundary geometries are heavy: select state_geom / county_geom only when drawing a map; use int_point_lat/int_point_lon for labels or point maps. Non-geometry columns cost ~KBs.

sources.name: us_states
sources.description: US states, DC and territories (56 rows incl. PR, GU, VI, AS, MP).
sources.grain: one row per state or territory

state_name.description: full name, e.g. 'California'; joins users.state for US users

county_geom.description: polygon (GEOGRAPHY), ~190 MB for all counties: filter by state first
